CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_access_student(_student_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select
    public.is_coordinator()
    or exists (
      select 1
      from public.students s
      join public.group_catechist gc
        on gc.group_id = s.group_id
      where s.id = _student_id
        and gc.profile_id = auth.uid()
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_pending_google_form_processed_responses(p_limit integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS SETOF google_form_processed_responses
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
begin
  return query
  with picked as (
    select id
    from public.google_form_processed_responses
    where processing_status = 'pending'
    order by first_seen_at asc
    limit p_limit
    for update skip locked
  ),
  updated as (
    update public.google_form_processed_responses g
    set
      processing_status = 'processing',
      processing_started_at = now(),
      error = null
    where g.id in (select id from picked)
    returning g.*
  )
  select * from updated;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cleanup_dni_verification_sessions()
 RETURNS TABLE(orphan_path text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  return query
  with borradas as (
    delete from public.dni_verification_sessions
    where expires_at < now()
    returning front_path, back_path
  )
  select p.path
  from borradas b
  cross join lateral (values (b.front_path), (b.back_path)) as p(path)
  where p.path is not null;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cleanup_expired_parent_email_verification_tokens()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
begin
  delete from public.parent_email_verification_tokens
  where expires_at < now();
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enqueue_birthday_pushes_now()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
begin
  perform net.http_post(
    url := (select decrypted_secret from vault.decrypted_secrets where name = 'project_url')
      || '/functions/v1/send-birthday-pushes',
    headers := jsonb_build_object(
      'Content-Type', 'application/json',
      'x-cron-secret', (select decrypted_secret from vault.decrypted_secrets where name = 'birthday_cron_secret')
    ),
    body := '{}'::jsonb,
    timeout_milliseconds := 10000
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_birthday_push_targets(p_day date DEFAULT NULL::date)
 RETURNS TABLE(notification_day date, recipient_id uuid, recipient_role text, notification_kind text, priority integer, birthday_count integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  with day_ref as (
    select coalesce(p_day, (now() at time zone 'Europe/Madrid')::date) as d
  ),

  recipients as (
    select
      p.id as recipient_id,
      p.role as recipient_role
    from public.profiles p
    where p.role in ('catechist', 'coordinator')
  ),

  recipient_groups as (
    select distinct
      gc.profile_id as recipient_id,
      gc.group_id
    from public.group_catechist gc
    join recipients r
      on r.recipient_id = gc.profile_id
  ),

  today_students as (
    select
      s.id as student_id,
      s.group_id
    from public.students s
    cross join day_ref d
    where s.birth_date is not null
      and public.is_birthday_on_day(s.birth_date::date, d.d)
  ),

  today_team as (
    select
      p.id as profile_id
    from public.profiles p
    cross join day_ref d
    where p.role in ('catechist', 'coordinator')
      and p.birth_date is not null
      and public.is_birthday_on_day(p.birth_date::date, d.d)
  ),

  catechist_student_counts as (
    select
      r.recipient_id,
      r.recipient_role,
      'student_birthdays_my_groups'::text as notification_kind,
      1 as priority,
      count(distinct ts.student_id)::int as birthday_count
    from recipients r
    join recipient_groups rg
      on rg.recipient_id = r.recipient_id
    join today_students ts
      on ts.group_id = rg.group_id
    where r.recipient_role = 'catechist'
    group by r.recipient_id, r.recipient_role
  ),

  coordinator_my_group_counts as (
    select
      r.recipient_id,
      r.recipient_role,
      'student_birthdays_my_groups'::text as notification_kind,
      1 as priority,
      count(distinct ts.student_id)::int as birthday_count
    from recipients r
    join recipient_groups rg
      on rg.recipient_id = r.recipient_id
    join today_students ts
      on ts.group_id = rg.group_id
    where r.recipient_role = 'coordinator'
    group by r.recipient_id, r.recipient_role
  ),

  coordinator_other_group_counts as (
    select
      r.recipient_id,
      r.recipient_role,
      'student_birthdays_other_groups'::text as notification_kind,
      2 as priority,
      count(distinct ts.student_id)::int as birthday_count
    from recipients r
    join today_students ts
      on true
    where r.recipient_role = 'coordinator'
      and not exists (
        select 1
        from recipient_groups rg
        where rg.recipient_id = r.recipient_id
          and rg.group_id = ts.group_id
      )
    group by r.recipient_id, r.recipient_role
  ),

  team_counts as (
    select
      r.recipient_id,
      r.recipient_role,
      'team_birthdays'::text as notification_kind,
      3 as priority,
      count(distinct tt.profile_id)::int as birthday_count
    from recipients r
    join today_team tt
      on true
    group by r.recipient_id, r.recipient_role
  ),

  unioned as (
    select * from catechist_student_counts
    union all
    select * from coordinator_my_group_counts
    union all
    select * from coordinator_other_group_counts
    union all
    select * from team_counts
  )

  select
    d.d as notification_day,
    u.recipient_id,
    u.recipient_role,
    u.notification_kind,
    u.priority,
    u.birthday_count
  from unioned u
  cross join day_ref d
  where u.birthday_count > 0
  order by u.recipient_id, u.priority;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_today_birthdays()
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, name text, age integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
  with today as (
    select (now() at time zone 'Europe/Madrid')::date as d
  )
  select
    p.id,
    coalesce(p.name, '') as name,
    extract(year from age(t.d, p.birth_date::date))::int as age
  from public.profiles p
  cross join today t
  where p.role in ('catechist', 'coordinator')
    and p.birth_date is not null
    and public.is_birthday_on_day(p.birth_date::date, t.d)
  order by p.name asc
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_today_student_birthdays_for_user()
 RETURNS TABLE(student_id uuid, student_name text, age integer, group_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
  with me as (
    select p.role
    from public.profiles p
    where p.id = auth.uid()
    limit 1
  ),
  today as (
    select (now() at time zone 'Europe/Madrid')::date as d
  ),
  eligible_students as (
    select
      s.id as student_id,
      s.name as student_name,
      s.birth_date::date as birth_date,
      s.group_id
    from public.students s
    cross join me
    where s.birth_date is not null
      and (
        me.role = 'coordinator'
        or exists (
          select 1
          from public.group_catechist gc
          where gc.profile_id = auth.uid()
            and gc.group_id = s.group_id
        )
      )
  )
  select
    es.student_id,
    coalesce(es.student_name, '') as student_name,
    extract(year from age(t.d, es.birth_date))::int as age,
    es.group_id
  from eligible_students es
  cross join today t
  where public.is_birthday_on_day(es.birth_date, t.d)
  order by es.student_name asc
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  bd date;
begin
  bd := nullif(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'birth_date', '')::date;

  insert into public.profiles (id, email, name, role, birth_date)
  values (
    new.id,
    new.email,
    coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'name', ''),
    coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'role', 'catechist'),
    bd
  )
  on conflict (id) do update
    set email      = excluded.email,
        name       = excluded.name,
        role       = excluded.role,
        birth_date = excluded.birth_date;

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_birthday_on_day(p_birth_date date, p_day date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  select
    case
      when p_birth_date is null then false

      when extract(month from p_birth_date) = extract(month from p_day)
       and extract(day   from p_birth_date) = extract(day   from p_day)
      then true

      when extract(month from p_birth_date) = 2
       and extract(day   from p_birth_date) = 29
       and extract(month from p_day) = 2
       and extract(day   from p_day) = 28
       and not (
         (
           mod(extract(year from p_day)::int, 4) = 0
           and mod(extract(year from p_day)::int, 100) <> 0
         )
         or mod(extract(year from p_day)::int, 400) = 0
       )
      then true

      else false
    end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_coordinator()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.profiles p
    where p.id = auth.uid()
      and p.role = 'coordinator'
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.regenerate_student_public_id(p_student_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(student_id uuid, public_id text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
declare
  new_public_id text;
begin
  new_public_id := public.generate_unique_student_public_id();

  insert into public.student_public_access (student_id, public_id)
  values (p_student_id, new_public_id)
  on conflict (student_id)
  do update set public_id = excluded.public_id;

  return query
  select spa.student_id, spa.public_id
  from public.student_public_access spa
  where spa.student_id = p_student_id;
end;
$function$
